## History

Dan Reese was a local [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) youth who hurled insults at [Faith Meredith](../character/faith.md) as she walked with [Walter Blythe](../character/walter.md). Later at school, Dan insulted both [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md), prompting [Walter](../character/walter.md) to defend them and challenge him to a fight. The following day after school, [Walter](../character/walter.md) fiercely defeated Dan in their fight.

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P1](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P2](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0002), [v5 CHAPTER XVI. ## Relationships

### [Walter](../character/walter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dan-reese--walter.md)

Dan Reese and [Walter Blythe](../character/walter.md) share a fierce mutual hatred that culminates in physical conflict. After Dan hurls insults at [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Walter](../character/walter.md) overcomes his own timid nature and anxiety to challenge Dan to a fight. Despite his fear, [Walter](../character/walter.md) passionately defeats Dan in the brawl, defending the girls' honor and earning the admiration of his community.

- Enemy of — mutual hatred  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XVI. TIT FOR TAT P20](../source/v05-c16.md#nw-v05-c16-p0020), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P8](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER XVII. A DOUBLE VICTORY P16](../source/v05-c17.md#nw-v05-c17-p0016), +3 more</sub>
